title: Check-In Time
intro: Welcome in to Disney Jeopardy! Tonight's episode is all about the places we crash after a twelve hour park day: Disney's resort hotels. Your room is ready, your Magic Band is charged, so let's check in.

categories.title: Aloha, Lilo
categories.intro: Our film category has some serious Polynesian Village energy. It's Lilo and Stitch, the 2002 animated original.

clues.clue: Stitch was created as an alien experiment. What is his experiment number?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 626. Even his number sounds a little chaotic.

clues.clue: What Hawaiian word means family, where nobody gets left behind or forgotten?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is ohana. Also the name of a famous restaurant at the Polynesian Village, with all you care to enjoy skewers.

clues.clue: Lilo is a huge fan of which singer, whose songs fill the movie's soundtrack?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Elvis Presley. Lilo even tries to teach Stitch to be a model citizen by acting like the King. Thank you very much.

clues.clue: Which mad scientist alien created Experiment 626?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Jumba Jookiba. He calls it evil genius. Personally, I call it a very fluffy lawsuit waiting to happen.

clues.clue: What is the name of Lilo's lumpy homemade doll?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Scrump. Lilo made it herself, and it is adorable and terrifying at the same time.

categories.title: Room With a View
categories.intro: Let's tour the Walt Disney World resorts. Some of these views are worth the room rate. Some of them are a parking lot. Let's find out.

clues.clue: The monorail glides right through the giant A-frame building of which Walt Disney World resort?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Contemporary Resort. Where else can you eat breakfast while a train zooms through the lobby?

clues.clue: Which flagship resort, with white Victorian architecture and red roofs, sits on the Seven Seas Lagoon?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Grand Floridian Resort and Spa. Fancy, fancy. Pinkies up for afternoon tea.

clues.clue: At Disney's Animal Kingdom Lodge, guests can watch giraffes and zebras from their balconies across grassy areas called what?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is savannas. Waking up to a giraffe outside your window beats waking up to an alarm clock.

clues.clue: Disney's Wilderness Lodge, with its own erupting geyser, takes inspiration from which national park?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Yellowstone. The lodge is modeled on the Old Faithful Inn, and the geyser is a lot easier to visit.

clues.clue: Two resorts opened alongside Magic Kingdom on October 1, 1971: the Contemporary and which other?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Polynesian Village Resort. Over fifty years of Dole Whip on the beach. Not a bad retirement plan.

categories.title: Passport Check-In
categories.intro: Pack your bags. We're leaving Florida to visit Disney hotels around the globe, from Hawaii to Tokyo to Paris.

clues.clue: Which Disney resort and spa sits on the island of Oahu in Hawaii?
accept: aulani a disney resort and spa
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Aulani. Mickey in a Hawaiian shirt is the vacation energy we all need.

clues.clue: Which Tokyo DisneySea hotel is built right into the park itself, with Italian-style architecture?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Hotel MiraCosta. Some rooms overlook the park, so you can watch the shows in your pajamas.

clues.clue: Disney's Grand Californian Hotel in Anaheim celebrates which architectural style?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Arts and Crafts, also called Craftsman style. So much wood. So many cozy fireplaces.

clues.clue: The Disneyland Hotel's three towers are named Adventure, Frontier, and what?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Fantasy. Each tower is themed to its land, right down to the headboards that light up with fireworks.

clues.clue: Which Disneyland Paris hotel reopened in 2021 as a showcase for Marvel artwork?
accept: disney's hotel new york the art of marvel
hotel new york the art of marvel
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Disney's Hotel New York, The Art of Marvel. Superheroes in the hallways. Excelsior!

categories.title: Rhyme Time: Check-In
categories.intro: It's Rhyme Time, hotel edition! Every answer is two words that rhyme. Think fast, and tip your bellhop.

clues.clue: A hotel just for Mickey and Minnie, which is also a nickname for the whole Disney company.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mouse House. Mickey's place, and also where all of our vacation money ends up.

clues.clue: A giant room service dinner delivered to the castle's furry, grumpy prince.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Beast Feast. Be our guest, put our service to the test, and please use a napkin this time.

clues.clue: A cozy little reading corner reserved for Peter Pan's pirate nemesis.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Hook Nook. Just don't bring a ticking clock in there. He gets very jumpy.

clues.clue: Fantasia's magical mop-pusher, hired by housekeeping to sweep your suite.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Room Broom. Just never let Mickey give it a wizard hat. The flooding is not covered by the deposit.

clues.clue: The sleepwear of the Emperor's New Groove villain who turned Kuzco into a llama.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Yzma's Pajamas. Pull the lever, Kronk! Wrong lever!

categories.title: Do Not Disturb
categories.intro: After all that check-in excitement, our fan category is about Disney characters who really love a good nap. Hang that sign on the door.

clues.clue: Which of the Seven Dwarfs can barely keep his eyes open?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Sleepy. Honestly, after a park day, we are all Sleepy.

clues.clue: Princess Aurora falls into an enchanted sleep after pricking her finger on what?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the spindle of a spinning wheel. Maleficent did not hold back on the birthday gift.

clues.clue: Which Jungle Book python sings Trust in Me while trying to hypnotize Mowgli to sleep?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Kaa. Those spiral eyes are the original screensaver.

clues.clue: Which Alice in Wonderland tea party guest keeps dozing off and ends up stuffed in a teapot?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Dormouse. Calm him down with a little jam on his nose. That's real advice from the movie.

clues.clue: In Sleeping Beauty, which good fairy decides to put the whole kingdom to sleep until Briar Rose awakens?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Flora, the fairy in red. Leadership qualities, and she's still wrong about the dress being pink.
